_meta.description: Compose batch of two crosstab slots (control and variant arms of an experiment) over region x segment decorated with an OVERLAY_PROP_Z_CELL matrix overlay that runs a per-cell two-proportion z-test against the matching control cell. Each cell's value becomes the two-sided p-value as a float64. Cells are treated as success counts; the matching row margin on each slot is the sample size (n_target on the variant side, n_ref on the control side). Reuses the standardNormalCDF helper backing TEST_PROP_Z so the overlay p-value matches the row-test surface byte-for-byte for the same (success, n) pair. Math: p_t = variant_cell / variant_row_margin; p_r = control_cell / control_row_margin; pooled = (variant + control) / (n_t + n_r); se = sqrt(pooled * (1 - pooled) * (1/n_t + 1/n_r)); z = (p_t - p_r) / se; p = 2 * (1 - Phi(|z|)). Degenerate inputs (pooled in {0, 1}, missing row margin) produce NaN p-values with one PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO warning per affected cell. Inherently buffered — inferential overlays as a family stay buffered until a streamable-test path is plumbed (PRD Non-Goals).
